architecture.approach: Put one capability-based role matrix in @riaya/shared, consume it from the existing @Roles + RolesGuard on the server and from the backoffice navigation and route guards, delete the hand-written role checks, and render a localized 403 page for authenticated users whose role cannot open a route. Tenant scoping remains BP-010's concern: a role failure is 403, a tenant failure is 404.

components.name: permissions
components.description: Framework-free module in packages/shared with the four roles, the capability list, CAPABILITY_ROLES and can(role, capability).

components.name: RolesGuard
components.description: Accepts the shared role-name list and denies when the role is missing, unknown, or not listed.

components.name: Roles
components.description: Decorator signature accepts the shared role-name type.

components.name: UsersController
components.description: Uses the staff-management matrix entry instead of a literal role list.

components.name: TenancyController
components.description: Adds RolesGuard and the matrix entries to invite and suspend, and removes the hand-written role branches.

components.name: OnboardingService
components.description: Removes assertCanInvite; the guard owns the role decision.

components.name: roles
components.description: Backoffice NAV_ROLES and canSee derive from the shared capabilities.

components.name: RoleRoute
components.description: Takes a capability and renders ForbiddenPage instead of redirecting to /.

components.name: App
components.description: Route guards use capabilities from the shared matrix.

components.name: ForbiddenPage
components.description: Localized 403 page inside the shell with a back link.

dataModel.flowDescription: No persistence change. The role matrix is code in @riaya/shared; no Prisma model or migration is touched.

securityConsiderations.description: The server is the authorization boundary. Client navigation hiding mirrors the same matrix but is never sufficient; every role-gated endpoint enforces @Roles before its handler.
A role failure returns 403 without revealing whether a tenant-scoped row exists; tenant lookups keep BP-010's 404.

dependencies.name: @riaya/shared
dependencies.notes: Already a dependency of both apps; the permissions module is added inside it.

dependencies.name: react-router-dom
dependencies.notes: Route guards and the 403 route already exist.

dependencies.name: @nestjs/common
dependencies.notes: Existing @Roles and RolesGuard are extended, not replaced.

risks.description: The matrix drifts from the endpoint list as controllers are added.
risks.mitigation: The classification table in plan.md is part of review, and a new endpoint must be added to it.

risks.description: A manual role check survives the refactor.
risks.mitigation: Delete assertCanInvite and the suspend branch; the test agent exercises every role.
Generic copy with no path display.

risks.description: Stale client role after a workspace switch.
risks.mitigation: The switch reloads, and the matrix is read from the reloaded session.
